 A vote for Cook is a vote for people and positive change
 By 
 Contributed 
 Nov 16, 2026
 Zoe Cook is The Greens’ Murray Plains candidate in the 2026 Victorian election.
 Photo by
 Riverine Herald
 With early voting in the Victorian election opening this week, The Riv has given all of the Murray Plains candidates one last opportunity to pitch themselves to voters.
 All candidates were offered 300 words to make their final appeal for votes.
 This article was written by Zoe Cook, The Greens’ candidate.
 Everyone in Murray Plains deserves to live a good and meaningful life.
 Hold tight - we’re checking permissions before loading more content
 A vote for me, your Greens candidate Zoe Cook — is a vote for hope for a better future where we bring compassion, not austerity, to our politics, because I’m from here and I care about our communities.
 The big banks, fossil fuel companies and gambling corporations have for too long been extracting billions of dollars of profit from our communities.
 By making these corporations pay their fair share, we can invest that revenue into looking after people in Murray Plains.
 We can fully fund our schools, so no matter what size your school is, our kids get the support and learning opportunities they deserve.
 We can invest in community infrastructure like local swimming pools, so kids and adults alike have local access to safely swim, cool down and have fun.
 We can build public housing, bring VicRoads back into public ownership, and invest in frequent public transport across Murray Plains, so people can live and travel safely and affordably throughout our region.
 We can improve healthcare for all Victorians, make dental healthcare free, and increase support for people with disabilities and carers.
 We can provide better public sexual healthcare in regional towns and ensure it’s safe and easily accessible, especially for our LGBTQIA+ communities.
 We can walk together with our First Nations’ communities by upholding Treaty and implementing the recommendations from the Yoorrook Commission that will make society fairer for everyone.
 We can invest in protecting our environment and fund First Nations-led work protecting and restoring country.
 Better things are possible.
 Our hope for a better future for everyone is built on grassroots democracy, peace and non-violence, social and economic justice, and environmental sustainability.
 Tell the politicians you want positive change.
 Vote 1 Zoe Cook and the Victorian Greens.
